_readme: This is the file to edit when you want spawning to feel different. Nothing
here needs code changes — reload the game and the new numbers apply.
Weights are relative, never absolute, and never a filter. A category with a
low weight still spawns, just rarely. Nothing is ever zero.
contrast  — how much the weights actually matter. The raw weight is
raised to this power before anything is picked, so 0.55 turns
a 10-vs-1 spread into about 3.5-vs-1. Set it to 1 to feel the
weights exactly as written, or 0 to make every category
equally likely. Lower = less noticeable difference between
outOfWindowMultiplier — what a category is worth outside its hours. This
is a multiplier, not a gate: a grocery store at 3am is still
Times are the device's local clock, 24-hour. A window whose end is before
its start wraps past midnight, so ["22:00","02:00"] works as you'd expect.

dungeons._note: One alive per zone at a time. Clear it and the next appears after regapMinutes, somewhere else.

instances._note: One or two per zone per day, rolled once and stable across reloads. Time windows decide where, not whether.

locations._note: The 11 procedural sites per zone. These are placed then nudged onto something real; this decides what 'something real' means.
